Welcome to our camp
Welcome to Mnyalukolo Tented Camp, your perfect mid-range gateway to an authentic African safari experience in the heart of the Serengeti. Located in the beautiful Nyabon gati area of Central Serengeti, our camp is renowned for its tranquil environment surrounded by raw nature and spectacular wildlife. We are situated just 21 to 23 kilometers from the Seronera Airstrip, making it a convenient 15- to 20-minute drive to reach us after your flight. In fact, your journey to the camp is often an exciting game drive in itself, as you may spot various species of wild animals along the way.
At Mnyalukolo Tented Camp, we offer comfortable accommodations designed to provide you with a memorable stay. Our rooms can comfortably accommodate from 1 to 4 guests, making them ideal for solo travelers, couples, and families alike. The decor, furniture, and room accessories have been carefully selected to suit the high expectations of our visitors, blending modern comfort with an authentic safari style. Every tent is fully equipped with hot water facilities and internet access in public areas to ensure you stay connected while enjoying the African bush.
Read more
Whether you are looking to witness the Great Migration, embark on guided game drives, or simply relax around the fire under the starry Serengeti sky, Mnyalukolo Tented Camp offers an unforgettable experience. Our guests consistently rate us highly for the warmth and hospitality of our staff, the quality of our delicious meals, and our prime location that lets you hear the sounds of the animals at night. Come and experience the magic of the Serengeti with us, where every detail of your safari is taken care of.
